# Boomer Automation Inc.

> Boomer Automation builds connected digital growth systems for Ontario businesses: websites, SEO, Google Ads, lead capture, tracking, and workflow automation.

## Canonical website

- https://boomerautomation.com/

## Core pages

- [Home](https://boomerautomation.com/): Company overview and connected-system approach.
- [Services](https://boomerautomation.com/services): Website packages, SEO, Google Ads, lead capture, automation, tracking, add-ons, and platform guidance.
- [Systems](https://boomerautomation.com/systems): Operating model connecting traffic, conversion, routing, follow-up, and measurement.
- [Process](https://boomerautomation.com/process): Discovery, planning, design, build, launch, handoff, support, and improvement.
- [Portfolio](https://boomerautomation.com/portfolio): Selected real client website projects.
- [Resources](https://boomerautomation.com/resources): Website strategy/pricing and paid advertising guides.
- [About](https://boomerautomation.com/about): Company philosophy and approach.
- [Contact](https://boomerautomation.com/contact): Project inquiry form and verified contact information.
- [Privacy](https://boomerautomation.com/privacy): Information collection, analytics, forms, retention, and privacy practices.

## Primary services

- Custom-coded websites
- WordPress websites
- E-commerce websites
- Search engine optimization
- Google Ads campaign planning and management
- Lead capture systems
- CRM-compatible workflow automation
- Conversion tracking and reporting

## Scope notes

- Hosting may be configured on Netlify or WordPress, but clients pay the hosting provider directly.
- Significant copywriting and image manipulation are add-ons or premium-scope work.
- The proprietary Boomer CRM is not currently offered as a finished client product.
- Booking integration and additional-language packages are not advertised as included services.
